turn_text: KRWC presents election 2020, now a special candidate profile from KRWC.

I'm US Senator Tina Smith, and I'm running for re-election to the United States Senate. COVID is like an earthquake that has shaken the foundations of our economic health and well-being. It's personal. It's your job, your family's health. the businesses that you've built, your kids' schools. And we really are all in this together. And we all have to take responsibility. COVID can touch any of us. In the midst of this worry and uncertainty and division like I've never seen before, I want you to know that I am working hard for you in Washington. I've listened and then I've gone to work with Republicans and Democrats to pass more than two dozen of my bills and measures into law. I've worked to help lower prescription drug costs, expand rural broadband, support mental health, make COVID tests free for everyone, and I helped write and pass the strong bipartisan 2018 Farm Bill. There is so much at stake in this election and so much work to do, especially now. Almost three years ago, I became your United States Senator, and two years ago, you elected me and sent me back to Washington. And now every time I go to Washington, I'm thinking about you and working for you, for your healthcare, your schools, your retirement, and your family's opportunity. I think we need leaders in this moment who know how to do the work and get results. That's the kind of Senator I've been and I'm so proud to represent you in Washington. And I ask for your support so that we can continue this work together.
